validity_findings: SELF-FULFILLING-CERTIFICATE: EXECUTE authored both the kernel repair (src/spider/kernel.py) and the certificate harness (run_certificate.py, fixture.py). Mitigations declared in prereg.md section 8.1 are all exercised and pass: (1) AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP refuses 24/24 declared negatives (refusal_rate=1.0), falsifying an always-EXECUTABLE kernel; (2) held-out identifiers (itm-0009, epsilon, tok-99, res-z, (t9,i9), n-09) are absent from induction observations; (3) NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT degenerate variant is detected (contrast_rate=0.0, degenerate_variant_detected=true); (4) fixture bank is text-frozen in prereg.md/spec.md (hashed by freeze.json) and sha256 recorded; (5) no pathological counts (EXECUTABLE rate on negatives=0, refusal_rate=1.0); (6) B-LITERAL-KERNEL shows 0/6 EXECUTABLE on held-out, establishing causal attribution to the in-scope repair. AUDIT independently rebuilt the fixture from prereg.md and verified the certificate against the recorded post-repair kernel blob (b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796).

SUPPORT-INFERENCE NARROWNESS: The _infer_support() function derives anchored regexes from the finite induction values, producing descriptors narrower than the declared grammars in prereg.md Table 5. Examples: F1-PATH-ID declared ^[a-z]+-[0-9]{4}$ but inferred ^itm\-000[0-9]{1}$ (accepts itm-0009 but rejects itm-0010); F2-QUERY-ID declared ^[a-z]{4,8}$ but inferred ^[a-z]+$ (accepts epsilon but also over-accepts); F6-NOISE-STRESS declared ^n-[0-9]{2}$ but inferred ^n\-0[0-9]{1}$. The held-out values were chosen to match the narrow inferred supports. The producer acknowledges this in result.json.validity_notes[3] as a 'bounded-fixture artefact, not a claim of general grammar induction.' This narrowness means selectivity is demonstrated only against the specific declared negatives with these specific induction values, not against the full declared grammars.

FIXED CONFIDENCE POLICY: _parameterized_confidence() returns hardcoded 0.9, which clears the unchanged min_confidence=0.8 threshold. This is a design choice to satisfy the frozen decision rule (parameterized mechanisms must reach EXECUTABLE), not a calibrated confidence estimator. The producer acknowledges in result.json.unresolved[1] that calibration against real induction data is untested. The literal distill() remains at hardcoded 0.5 so B-LITERAL-KERNEL stays reproducible.

SYNTHETIC FIXTURE AND COMPARATOR: SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 is a deterministic, credential-free synthetic fixture (6 families, 4 induction + 1 held-out each). B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED comparator is a K=5 structural field-overlap Jaccard matcher over flattened key paths of intent+state+action -- not a real LLM retrieval arm. The treatment contrast (treatment != comparator on 6/6 cases) demonstrates the parameterized kernel path produces different actions than a nearest-neighbor retrieval simulator on this fixture. It does not demonstrate differentiation from a real LLM-based retrieval arm or on real Web sites. The producer correctly bounds this in spec.json.measurement_validity[6] and report.md section 6.

FREEZE SUBSTITUTE FOR CODE: freeze.json hashes only request.json, spec.json, prereg.md. The kernel code is not directly hash-bound. The documented preregistered substitute (spec.json.measurement_validity[3], prereg.md section 4) is used: (a) fixture text-frozen in prereg.md/spec.json (hashed by freeze.json); (b) fixture deterministically reconstructed and sha256 recorded (89a98e5de84a7f56dc8bdb966695db91aca6333743890be3bdc319df3e8c5427); (c) pre-repair (cfec98660b0277ccbf295e8a4119e8d81ddccf50) and post-repair (b15ed8487e2d1326df4ca64fb4c7b6e5a0ebf796) kernel git blob identities recorded; (d) behavioral checks (AD-POSITIVE-ROUNDTRIP, AD-NEGATIVE-ROUNDTRIP, AD-TREATMENT-CONTRAST, PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY) are behavior-bound and cannot be satisfied without the required behavior. AUDIT verified the fixture sha256 and kernel blob identities match the recorded values.

REPRESENTATION LOSS: The in-scope repair covers only 6 synthetic families with single-field (F1-F4, F6) and two-field (F5) action templates. Noise fields (trace_id, seq, ts, nonce) vary in state/next_state but are correctly excluded from parameter slots (declared vs inferred slot counts match for all families including F6-NOISE-STRESS). Results do not generalize to arbitrary DOM/browser mechanisms, multi-step browser sessions, freshness/delta-repair, or cross-site transfer. This loss is disclosed in prereg.md section 8.6 and result.json.validity_notes[4].

COUNTER HONESTY: model_calls and model_tokens are zero for the certificate execution (no model invoked). PC-ACCOUNTING-FIDELITY exercises model counters only on an explicitly injected synthetic event (step 3, injected=true) and labels them as injected. The producer correctly reports unexercised counters as null/not-exercised in result.json.metrics.note, not as measured zeros. Inherited-path counters (retrieval_calls, verification_calls, repair_attempts) increment on real mechanism executions as required.

NO MODEL CREDENTIAL: As designed, no model credential was available or required. The four-arm cold/instructions/retrieval/SPIDER benchmark remains unexecuted. This is not a failure of this experiment -- the mandate explicitly scoped this to the credential-free arm-differentiation certificate.
baseline_findings: B-LITERAL-KERNEL (causal-attribution control): PASS. Pre-repair literal semantics (distill() confidence=0.5 vs resolve() min_confidence=0.8) produces 0/6 EXECUTABLE on held-out in-support set. On exact induction states, literal candidates exist but resolve to EXPLORE at confidence 0.5. This establishes that observed liveness is attributable to the in-scope parameterized repair, not the pre-existing literal path. AUDIT verified by inspecting kernel.py lines 226-245 (distill confidence 0.5) and lines 456-462 (min_confidence 0.8 threshold).

B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED (comparator, non-gating): Records comparator action per case via deterministic K=5 structural Jaccard. On all 6 families, comparator action differs from treatment action (e.g., F1: itm-0001 vs itm-0009; F5: t1/i1 vs t9/i9). This is a retrieval-shaped action source only, not a claim about real retrieval quality. The contrast is real and measurable on the fixture.

NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT (degenerate-treatment null control): PASS. Forced variant with treatment_action := comparator_action yields contrast_rate=0.0 and is reported as certificate failure (degenerate_variant_detected=true). This demonstrates the certificate fires on a retrieval-in-disguise treatment, satisfying the discriminating-control requirement that a certificate must detect a degenerate treatment before any real arm is trusted.
claim_ceiling: The arm-differentiation certificate is established for the shipped kernel on the synthetic SYNTH-INDUCTION-BANK-v1 fixture: (1) Liveness -- parameterized mechanisms resolve EXECUTABLE with correctly bound actions for 6/6 held-out in-support identifiers; (2) Selectivity -- 24/24 declared negatives (out-of-support empty/space/slash, missing parameters, out-of-support pair, wrong intent) are refused with bound_action=null and non-empty reasons; (3) Arm differentiation -- treatment actions differ from the B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED structural comparator on 6/6 cases, and the NC-ZERO-CONTRAST-TREATMENT degenerate variant (treatment := comparator) is detected as zero contrast; (4) Accounting fidelity -- seeded trajectory max_relative_error=0.0; inherited-path counters increment retrieval_calls=3, verification_calls=2, repair_attempts=1 on a real mechanism execution; model counters fire only on explicitly injected events. Causal attribution is established via B-LITERAL-KERNEL (0/6 EXECUTABLE on pre-repair literal path). This certificate does NOT establish C-LLM-INHERIT (remains HYPOTHESIS), does not demonstrate real-Web or LLM-inheritance benefit, does not test the four-arm benchmark, and the support-inference narrowness bounds selectivity to the specific declared negatives with these specific induction values. The fixed 0.9 confidence policy is a design choice, not a calibrated threshold. The B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED comparator is a deterministic structural similarity matcher, not a real LLM retrieval arm. The kernel change is provisionable in scope (src/spider/kernel.py) and the behavioural checks are behaviour-bound per the documented freeze substitute.

unresolved: The downstream four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark (A-SPIDER vs B-COLD, B-INSTRUCTIONS, B-RETRIEVAL) has not been run and cannot yield product evidence until a programmatic model endpoint credential is provisioned.
Whether the confidence-0.9 parameterized policy is well-calibrated against real induction data is untested; it is a fixed policy chosen to clear the frozen 0.8 threshold on the synthetic fixture.
Generalization of the parameterized distillation path beyond the six synthetic families (real sites, richer action grammars, fresh/repair dynamics) is untested.
The support-inference narrowness (inferred supports narrower than declared grammars) should be re-examined before relying on it for real out-of-support rejection.
The B-RETRIEVAL-SHAPED comparator is a structural Jaccard matcher; whether a real LLM retrieval arm would produce different contrast patterns on real tasks is unknown.

The kernel's literal distill() path remains at confidence 0.5 while parameterized path gets 0.9; whether this confidence gap is the right long-term design or a temporary gate-clearing measure is unresolved.
The parameterized path uses a simple common-prefix + character-class support inference; more sophisticated grammar induction (e.g., regex learning from examples) is not implemented or tested.
